preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(piper_and_rats) - 1) if piper_and_rats[i:i+2] == '~O' and 'P' in piper_and_rats[i+2:])
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of rats going right ('~O') that appear before the Pied Piper ('P').
